# Puraniks Abitante Fiore

> Puraniks Abitante Fiore is a 45-acre hillside Italian Riviera-themed residential township in Bavdhan Budruk, Pune, developed by Puranik Builders Ltd. Offering 1, 2, 2.5 & 3 BHK residences with private Juliet Balcony Gardens, Club Azzurro, and Venetian lagoon pools starting from ₹59 Lakhs*.

## Core Projects & Residences
- [Official Website](https://puraniksabitante.in/): Master residential portal with verified inventory and direct developer pricing
- [1 BHK Flats](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-fiore-1-bhk): 489 sq.ft carpet oxygen homes starting ₹59 Lakhs*
- [2 BHK Smart Flats](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-fiore-2-bhk): 596 to 770 sq.ft carpet residences starting ₹72.99 Lakhs*
- [2.5 BHK Executive Suites](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-fiore-2-5-bhk): 867 to 908 sq.ft homes with dedicated study rooms
- [3 BHK Luxury Flats](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-fiore-3-bhk): 867 to 1,113 sq.ft residences with triple balconies from ₹1.10 Cr*
- [Price List & Cost Sheet](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-fiore-price): Verified 2026 pricing, payment schedules, and 0% stamp duty privilege
- [Floor Plans & Blueprints](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-floor-plans): Certified 2D AutoCAD and 3D architectural cut-sections
- [MahaRERA Legal Certificates](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-rera): Phase 2A (P52100020202 OC received), Phase 2B (P52100020238), Phase 2C (P52100048353), Phase 2C1 (P52100049352)
- [Bavdhan Location & Connectivity](https://puraniksabitante.in/bavdhan-connectivity): 5 mins from Chandani Chowk, 15 mins to Hinjewadi IT Park
- [Club Azzurro & Amenities](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-amenities): 25,000 sq.ft clubhouse, infinity lagoon pool, and mist cooling
- [Book VIP Site Visit](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-site-visit): Schedule private walkthrough with free AC cab pickup across Pune
- [Ready Possession Flats](https://puraniksabitante.in/puraniks-abitante-ready-possession): OC received ready-to-move-in flats under MahaRERA P52100020202
- [Puranik Builders Legacy](https://puraniksabitante.in/puranik-builders): 34+ years track record, 46+ delivered landmarks across Pune and MMR
